title: RHC Entity V2 Item Custody
description: EV2-11 unique-item custody record for an already-declared persistent `item:` identity. Current ownership and physical possession are two independent nullable facts: `owner_entity_id` is who the item belongs to and `holder_entity_id` is who currently carries it. Both are required fields that accept either JSON null or a `character:` / `party:` identity; `character:` covers PCs, NPCs and villains because those are role/classification differences rather than separate identity types, and `party:` supports party-owned/party-held custody. There is deliberately no stored status field: the human labels are derived only. `held` means holder is non-null (whether or not owner is the same actor); `owned` means owner is non-null and holder is null; `treasure` means both are null. Legitimate combinations include owned-and-held (owner=holder), stolen/loaned (owner and holder differ), owned-but-carried-by-none (holder null), carried-without-established-ownership (owner null), and treasure (both null). This record is the authoritative unique-item custody truth and is not mirrored inside ordinary `inventory`; it is not a second save engine, not an item-identity registry, and it does not admit or mint new `item:` identities (that is deferred to EV2-12). It also does not model equipped/attuned state, encumbrance, containers, ammunition, pricing/economy, crafting/durability, provenance, location/faction/creature custody, or alternate save-slot/reality architecture.
